what: Transfer verification: Across-XR and Questset pulled from AVALON to DESKTOP-C
authorisation: The user authorised the pull directly in the receiving session. A peer's relay of that authorisation was explicitly not treated as the approval.

per_file_verification.method: per file against the manifest, never totals - a total-against-total comparison cannot exclude two files differing in compensating directions

verifier_proven_in_both_directions.why: A verifier that has only ever returned PASS has not been shown capable of returning FAIL. Three negative controls were run against the real corpus.
verifier_proven_in_both_directions.neg_2_one_byte_size_change: detected, size_mismatch=1 (manifest=1048 disk=1047), rc=1 - the compensating-delta case the per-file rule exists for
verifier_proven_in_both_directions.neg_3_wrong_root: fixture check fired and STOPPED with a path-convention diagnosis, instead of reporting 123 missing and 123 extra which would read as catastrophe

CrossApplicationXR_Dataset.note: CITATION.txt sits INSIDE users/, so `ls | wc -l` over-counts by one here

Questset.note: CITATION.txt sits at the dataset ROOT, so `ls | wc -l` happens to be correct here

identities_landed.consequence: The off-by-one is corpus-dependent - it depends on where the citation file sits - so `find -maxdepth 1 -type d` should be used unconditionally rather than only on corpora known to carry one.

licence.note: Neither is BOXRR-derived, so no DUA clause-4 question arises on this transfer. CITATION.txt is present in both trees. Do NOT reason about these under the BOXRR agreement, and do not apply their freedoms to BOXRR-derived data.
